summary: Resource modules return before (config before the task), after (config after) and the commands sent, shown with an NX-OS SNMP location change example.
questions: What does a resource module return?
How can I see what commands a resource module sent?

answer_card.title: Resource module return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `before`: resource config before the task
- `after`: resource config after the task
- `commands`: commands sent to the device

Example: changing SNMP location shows `before.location: Room E, Building 5...`, `after.location: Room E, Building 6...`, `commands: [snmp-server location Room E, Building 6, ...]`, `changed: true`.
